name: Taitō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Taitō ward emblem in white: an outlined six-pointed device with concave sides enclosing a ring with a horizontal bar and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Taitō, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 4 June 1965; the emblem dates from 18 April 1951.

features.role: Taitō ward emblem — an outlined six-pointed device with concave sides enclosing a ring with a horizontal bar and a disc
